text:
Four metals, P, Q, R and S, are separately reacted with dilute hydrochloric acid.
The table shows the observation for each metal.
metal
observation
P
lots of bubbles produced
Q
few bubbles produced
R
no bubbles produced
S
very few bubbles produced
What is the order of reactivity of these four metals, from most reactive to least reactive?
R → S → Q → P
A
P → S → Q → R
B
P → Q → S → R
C
Q → R → P → S
D
